answer: The retry limit of MAX_ATTEMPTS=7 allows PostgreSQL outbox to attempt event delivery up to 7 times before giving up. Event deduplication by event_id prevents duplicate processing if the same event is retried or received multiple times.

# PostgreSQL Outbox Retry and Deduplication

The MAX_ATTEMPTS=7 limit allows each outbox event up to 7 retry attempts before being marked as failed, ensuring eventual termination of failed message delivery attempts. The event_id deduplication prevents the same event from being processed multiple times, protecting against duplicate message delivery even if retries succeed across multiple processing cycles.
